data.name: Hairpin I
data.description: Has a built-in silencer. Great for stealth, but tricky in combat.
data.article: The Hairpin I is a pistol that uses Light Ammo. It is a common rarity weapon, notable for its built-in silencer, which makes it effective for stealth. Raiders can obtain it through scavenging, by crafting it at Workbench, or by purchasing it from Tian Wen. This item serves as a base for crafting more advanced versions, such as Hairpin II, Hairpin III, and Hairpin IV. It can also be recycled for various resources.

data.name: Hairpin IV
data.description: Has a built-in silencer. Great for stealth, but tricky in combat.
data.article:
The Hairpin IV is an upgraded slide-action Pistol that uses Light Ammo. It comes with a built-in silencer, making it suitable for stealth during encounters. Upgrading to Hairpin IV increases its fire rate, reduces its reload time, and boosts its durability compared to previous versions.

You can craft the Hairpin IV by upgrading a Hairpin III at a Gunsmith, using various other materials. It can also be recycled or salvaged to recover some resources. When sold, it fetches 2,900 coins.

data.name: Heavy Ammo
data.description: Heavy bullets used mainly with large-caliber weapons.
data.article:
Heavy Ammo is a type of ammunition for high-caliber weapons. It helps you take down ARCs more effectively because it can penetrate their armor better than Medium Ammo and Light Ammo, though it is not as strong as Launcher Ammo.

You can find Heavy Ammo by scavenging, or it might drop from defeated ARCs such as the Rocketeer, Rocketeer Husk, and Sentinel. It can also be found in Raider Caches or purchased from the vendor Tian Wen. You can craft it at a Workbench.

arc.name: Sentinel
arc.description:
A large unarmored turret that sits atop buildings and ledges. Often found outside and usually very high up. Contains a small vulnerable capsule attached to its swiveling arm.

Traces movement and will fire off a single Heavy round every 5 seconds while having line-of-sight on a Raider.

arc.name: Rocketeer
arc.description: This is a formidable flying ARC, a pure engine of destruction that dominates the airspace. It poses a significant threat not just because it flies, but because of its powerful rocket attacks and devastating focus on area-of-effect (AoE) damage. This unit is designed to saturate an area, turning cover into a liability and forcing Raiders to constantly relocate or be wiped out by the sheer force of its explosions. Treat it like a mobile artillery piece—it hits hard and wide.

arc.name: Vaporizer
arc.description: The Vaporizer is a large, airborne ARC machine, which quickly gained notoriety among Raiders for its devastating lasers and volatile, unpredictable attack patterns.

data.name: Heavy Gun Parts Blueprint
data.description: Used directly in crafting items of all tiers.
data.article: The Heavy Gun Parts Blueprint is a schematic that teaches you how to craft Heavy Gun Parts at a Refiner. This process requires crafting materials as ingredients. They are then used to upgrade, craft, and repair various weapons, and are also a component in creating other items at a Gunsmith.

arc.name: ARC Surveyor
arc.description: This is the largest of the rolling ARCs, a massive, spherical construct designed to dominate open ground. Its primary tactic is to stop periodically on the battlefield to transmit disruptive signals, acting as a massive relay for the ARC network. Be warned, however, its most unique (and dangerous) trait is its resilience: as it takes damage, its outer shell breaks apart into many smaller, armored pieces. Its final attack is a relentless one: it will roll directly at high speed toward any Raider it detects, essentially turning itself into a giant, high-impact bowling ball.

data.name: Heavy Shield
data.description: A heavy shield that blocks a large portion of incoming damage, but carries a significant cost to mobility.
data.article: The Heavy Shield is an equipable item that blocks a large portion of incoming damage, though it reduces your character's movement speed. To use this shield, Raiders must have specific augmentations equipped, including Combat Mk. 2, Combat Mk. 3 (Aggressive), Looting Mk. 3 (Safekeeper), or Tactical Mk. 3 (Defensive). It can be crafted at a Gear Bench, found through scavenging, or purchased from Lance with coins. This item can be repaired with resources or recycled into other materials.

data.name: Herbal Bandage
data.description: An improvised medical item that gradually restores health over time.
data.article: The Herbal Bandage is an improvised medical item that slowly restores your health over time. When used, it heals you for 3.5 health per second over 10 seconds. You can craft this item at a Medical Lab using salvage materials. Alternatively, it can be crafted if you have the Traveling Tinkerer skill. It can also be obtained from certain in-game decks.

data.description: Moderately reduces both vertical recoil and horizontal recoil.
data.flavor_text: 30% Reduced Horizontal Recoil - 30% Reduced ADS Speed
data.article: The Horizontal Grip is a weapon modification that helps improve stability when firing. When attached to a compatible weapon, it reduces both vertical recoil and horizontal recoil by 30%. This grip also causes a 30% reduction in the speed at which Raiders can aim down sights. This modification can be broken down into various components and resources through recycling.

data.name: Hornet Driver
data.description: Can be recycled into ARC Alloy.
data.article:
The Hornet Driver is a thrown item that temporarily stuns nearby Hornets for seven seconds and other Raiders for half a second within a six-meter range. It is obtained by scavenging destroyed Hornets. Once thrown, a Damaged Hornet Driver can be retrieved from where it landed.

This item is used to craft tools. It is also required to upgrade the Gear Bench and progress through the The Trifecta quest. Additionally, it contributes to the Trophy Display project.

arc.name: Hornet
arc.description: This is a medium-class drone, easily recognizable by the pair of armored rotors mounted prominently on its front. It rarely operates alone, preferring to patrol the skies alongside a swarm of Wasps or to act as an aerial shield for a larger, ground-based ARC. Its main attack is a focused, high-speed projectile. Watch for the brief, one-second pulse of a red aiming laser—that's your warning before it fires a specialized stun round designed to shred Raider shields and tear through light armor almost instantly.

data.name: Household Cleaner
data.description: Can be recycled into chemicals.
data.article: The Household Cleaner is an uncommon item that serves as a valuable source of crafting materials. You can recycle this item to break it down into various resources, which are important for your crafting and upgrade efforts. To obtain it, search containers and explore residential areas.

data.article: The Hullcracker Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Hullcracker I at the Gunsmith. You can obtain this blueprint as a reward upon completing the quest called "The Major's Footlocker". For an overview of available tasks, visit the Quests page.
